---
title: "Pilot Movie Ratings on the Left-Right Scale"
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
main_file <- sort(
  list.files("pilot_data", pattern = "^main_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE),
  decreasing = TRUE
)[1]

if (length(main_file) == 0 || is.na(main_file)) {
  stop("No pilot_data/main_*.csv file was found.")
}

main_data <- read.csv(main_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

movie_data <- main_data[
  !is.na(main_data[["player.movie_political_vibe"]]) &
    nzchar(main_data[["player.assigned_movie_title"]]),
  c(
    "player.assigned_movie_title",
    "player.assigned_movie_category",
    "player.movie_political_vibe"
  )
]

names(movie_data) <- c("movie_title", "movie_category", "movie_rating")
movie_data$movie_rating <- as.numeric(movie_data$movie_rating)

summarize_movie <- function(df) {
  n_ratings <- nrow(df)
  mean_rating <- mean(df$movie_rating)
  sd_rating <- stats::sd(df$movie_rating)
  se_rating <- sd_rating / sqrt(n_ratings)
  ci_margin <- 1.96 * se_rating

  data.frame(
    movie_title = df$movie_title[1],
    movie_category = df$movie_category[1],
    n = n_ratings,
    mean_rating = mean_rating,
    sd_rating = sd_rating,
    ci_low = mean_rating - ci_margin,
    ci_high = mean_rating + ci_margin,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

movie_stats <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(split(movie_data, movie_data$movie_title), summarize_movie)
)

movie_stats <- movie_stats[order(movie_stats$mean_rating, movie_stats$movie_title), ]
row.names(movie_stats) <- NULL

movie_stats$ci_display <- sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", movie_stats$ci_low, movie_stats$ci_high)
movie_stats$mean_display <- sprintf("%.2f", movie_stats$mean_rating)
movie_stats$movie_title <- factor(movie_stats$movie_title, levels = movie_stats$movie_title)

write.csv(
  movie_stats[, c("movie_title", "movie_category", "n", "mean_rating", "sd_rating", "ci_low", "ci_high")],
  "pilot_movie_left_right_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

summary_table <- movie_stats[, c("movie_title", "movie_category", "mean_display", "ci_display", "n")]
names(summary_table) <- c("Movie", "Category", "Mean rating", "95% CI", "N")
```

This report uses `r basename(main_file)` from `/pilot_data` and orders movies from lower to higher mean placement on the 1 to 7 left-right scale.

## Summary Table

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  summary_table,
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Pilot movie ratings on the left-right scale"
)
```

## Chart

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
x_pos <- seq_len(nrow(movie_stats))

par(mar = c(10, 5, 2, 1) + 0.1, las = 1)

plot(
  x_pos,
  movie_stats$mean_rating,
  type = "n",
  xaxt = "n",
  xlab = "",
  ylab = "Mean rating (95% CI)",
  ylim = c(1, 7),
  xlim = c(0.4, nrow(movie_stats) + 0.6)
)

usr <- par("usr")
rect(
  xleft = usr[1],
  ybottom = 3.75,
  xright = usr[2],
  ytop = 4.25,
  col = grDevices::adjustcolor("grey70", alpha.f = 0.2),
  border = NA
)

abline(h = seq(1, 7, by = 1), col = "grey85", lwd = 1.2)
abline(h = seq(1.5, 6.5, by = 1), col = "grey92", lwd = 0.8)
abline(v = x_pos, col = "grey88", lwd = 0.8)
abline(h = 4, col = "grey45", lty = 2, lwd = 1.2)

segments(
  x0 = x_pos,
  y0 = movie_stats$ci_low,
  x1 = x_pos,
  y1 = movie_stats$ci_high,
  lwd = 1.6
)
segments(
  x0 = x_pos - 0.08,
  y0 = movie_stats$ci_low,
  x1 = x_pos + 0.08,
  y1 = movie_stats$ci_low,
  lwd = 1.6
)
segments(
  x0 = x_pos - 0.08,
  y0 = movie_stats$ci_high,
  x1 = x_pos + 0.08,
  y1 = movie_stats$ci_high,
  lwd = 1.6
)
points(
  x_pos,
  movie_stats$mean_rating,
  pch = 19,
  cex = 1.5
)

axis(
  side = 1,
  at = x_pos,
  labels = levels(movie_stats$movie_title),
  las = 2,
  cex.axis = 0.9
)
box(bty = "l")
```
